sql:
WITH SeniorityMedian AS (
  SELECT
    seniority,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY comp_mid_usd) AS median_comp_mid_usd
  FROM fct_posting
  WHERE remote_us = TRUE AND is_open = TRUE
  GROUP BY
    seniority
),
OverallMedian AS (
  SELECT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY comp_mid_usd) AS overall_median_comp_mid_usd
  FROM fct_posting
  WHERE remote_us = TRUE AND is_open = TRUE
)
SELECT
  sm.seniority,
  sm.median_comp_mid_usd,
  sm.median_comp_mid_usd - om.overall_median_comp_mid_usd AS difference_from_overall
FROM SeniorityMedian sm
CROSS JOIN OverallMedian om;
